timing_contract: Each arm one warm, three measured and one comparison; history encode/shadow separately measured; online actions contain proxy, selection, packing, selected compute and merge. Observer effects and host journal overhead noted in underlying RUN.
limitations: Only two exposed sources and one block per expert; no video or quality acceptance.
Original h/x, retained outputs and selected tensors and the current arm cache coexist; cumulative peak is not a deployed single-arm peak.
Selected-old recomputation error is measured, not a byte-lossless guarantee or full-video evidence.
Physical I/O and uninstrumented metadata reads are unknown.
